experts.name: Dr. Aris Thorne
experts.notes: Nadi-9 exhibits rigid verbal morphology. The -ina suffix is exclusively imperfective/durative. Do not accept translations where -ina is attached to completed past actions.

experts.name: Prof. Meera Kulkarni
experts.notes: Honorific systems in Nadi-9 reflect emotional proximity rather than pure social rank. Sibling address 'da-bhai' can shift to detached 'bhai-raj' when formal estrangement or legal confrontation occurs.

experts.name: Linguist John H.
experts.notes: Dictionary A was scraped from an unverified database and contains several OCR / vendor corruptions, notably terms relating to precious metals and court etiquette. Trust Dictionary B or live audio over Dictionary A when in conflict.
